summary: Defines Nile platform roles, approval boundaries, and governance responsibilities. This document is process- and authority-oriented and does not define Terraform-plan-checkable resource requirements.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). This pack records process-only controls from the platform roles document; no policy evaluates plan fields.

controls.title: Platform Engineer responsibilities and access boundaries are documented
controls.obligation: Platform Engineers design and maintain factories and validation rules while production changes occur only through factory executions and CI/CD workflows.
controls.reason: Role responsibilities and human access pathways are organizational process requirements, not Terraform plan attributes.

controls.title: Policy ownership and approval authority are assigned
controls.obligation: Policy Owners maintain the policy catalog and approve policy and control-matrix changes.
controls.reason: Approval authority and stewardship assignments are governance workflow requirements, not resource configuration in a plan.

controls.title: Platform Consumers provide mandatory workload metadata
controls.obligation: Platform Consumers provide accurate mandatory tagging values such as workload id, team, environment, cost center, and data classification when requesting infrastructure.
controls.reason: The document assigns responsibility for supplying metadata, but the enforceable tagging requirements belong to the separate tagging standard; this roles document does not itself define plan-level validation criteria.

controls.title: Architectural deviation and promotion approval roles are assigned
controls.obligation: Platform Architects approve architectural deviations and provide sign-off for Beta to Stable promotions.
controls.reason: Human review and approval responsibilities cannot be derived from Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Security review ownership is assigned
controls.obligation: Security Engineers own security-domain controls and review factories for alignment to security requirements.
controls.reason: Security governance ownership is process-only. Specific security resource requirements must come from separate policy documents to be plan-enforceable.

controls.title: Compliance reporting ownership is assigned
controls.obligation: Compliance Analysts map controls to frameworks and provide audit evidence from provisioning and monitoring records.
controls.reason: Audit evidence and reporting duties are organizational processes, not Terraform resource attributes.

controls.title: FinOps tagging oversight is assigned
controls.obligation: FinOps Analysts monitor tag coverage and use cost-center and team tags for chargeback reporting.
controls.reason: Monitoring and reporting responsibilities are process controls. Enforceable tag presence belongs in the tagging standard pack, not this roles document.

controls.title: Platform operations authority is bounded
controls.obligation: Platform Operations manages runtime infrastructure and break-glass production access through approved change and incident processes.
controls.reason: Operational authority, incident handling, and break-glass processes are not represented in Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Decision and exception authority boundaries are documented
controls.obligation: Governance stewardship, human approver authority, approval authority, and exception authority must follow the designated governance models.
controls.reason: Authority boundaries and escalation rules are human governance requirements and cannot be validated from planned resources.

controls.title: RACI assignments for governance activities are defined
controls.obligation: Key Nile governance activities must have documented responsible, accountable, consulted, and informed roles.
controls.reason: RACI assignments are documentation and process constructs with no direct Terraform plan representation.
